editorial:
You get a fun reunion of Resident Evil favorites when Jill, Leon, Claire, Chris, and Rebecca all chase different clues that lead to Alcatraz. The story mixes zombie chaos, a new T-Virus, a strange fish, and a kidnapped scientist, so there is always something happening. The animation looks sharp, and the action scenes are easy to follow. If you enjoy video game movies, this one feels like a big crossover event with plenty of fan service and familiar faces.

The pacing stays quick, and the voice acting helps sell the drama. Some dialogue is cheesy, and the plot can feel crowded, but the big set pieces make up for it. Fans of the games will likely have a great time, while newcomers may need a little patience.
endingExplained: In the final act, the heroes reach Alcatraz and face the villain behind the outbreak. They learn the separate cases connect through a plan to spread the new virus. After a big battle, the team stops the threat and escapes the island. The ending shows the danger is not fully gone, leaving room for another mission, but the main characters survive and the immediate crisis is over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Resident Evil, zombie action, and animated sci-fi horror.
